decisions.reason: As a door lever handle family that is very close to the firm's core knowledge and remained on the market beyond launch, it fits the firm's strong absorptive capacity and is likely worth retaining unless the range is streamlined.

This door handle design also builds on established design and engineering capabilities, but as a more style-specific offering it is somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning than a broader family product.

The electronic access system is close to the firm's existing offer yet strongly aligned with its move toward integrated digital building solutions, and the firm's in-house R&D gives it good scope to learn from and improve the product commercially.
